title: Capability entry of one domain in the handshake response (BC 5.4)

available.description: True when the domain's code is in this build and the device has the hardware. Not a state the user can change.

reason.description: Why the domain is not available.

methods.description: Every method native answers in this domain. Empty when not available.

events.description: Every event native can emit in this domain.

features.description: Named flags for optional behaviour. A missing flag means the feature is absent.
